programme.title: Second Sight Paranormal
programme.desc: In St. Francisville, Louisiana lies the picturesque Myrtles Plantation. Situated 26 miles from Baton Rouge, it may not be the grandest of plantations, but what it lacks in presentation, it makes up for in disturbing history and lore. Owned by the Moss family, it’s touted as one of the most haunted places in America! Visitors have reported seeing apparitions, lights turning on and off, faces and handprints in mirrors, vanishing objects; hearing random footsteps, rattling doorknobs, children’s cries, and unexplained smells. The Myrtles Plantation has been featured on “Ghost Hunters,” “Ghost Adventures,” ”Unsolved Mysteries” and “Most Terrifying Places in America.”But is this plantation the paranormal hotspot it’s claimed to be? Does it hold the dark and tragic history of poisonings, hangings, mutilation, murder, and gunfire claimed? Can fact be separated from fiction? Ericka and her team are about to find out.

programme.title: Second Sight Paranormal
programme.desc: After Dr. John Bell's unexpected suicide, owners of his home begin to experience strange noises, ghost sightings and discover creepy bloodstains on the floor. Second Sight Paranormal TV is called to investigate the haunted house and find out why Dr. Bell still lingers and what he wants. They soon discover he's not haunting alone.

programme.title: Second Sight Paranormal
programme.desc: The historic red-light district of Pensacola was a place where you could find a good time. But in the modern era, you might just find something paranormal. Second Sight digs into the district’s many notably haunted spots of museums, restaurants, and theaters, seeking spirits that linger from a history of depravity and debauchery.

programme.title: Second Sight Paranormal
programme.desc: Fort Morgan and Fort Blakeley once housed many soldiers and slaves. Those same souls may still reside within these aged structures built in times of war. Night descends as Second Sight seeks out the lost souls of war and peel back the dark history behind these historic locations.

programme.title: Second Sight Paranormal
programme.desc: The DAR House of Mobile, Alabama has remained since 1860 as a historic location for weddings and dinner parties. But a part of the past remains as ghost activity occupies its walls.
